source.check: returned unopposed: named in the Impartial Reporter's nominations report of 21 May 1964 (p. 7); Colebrooke was the only Lisnaskea division with two nominations

note: Triennial election of Lisnaskea Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. One contest, for the Colebrook seat, the only contest for the council. The other thirty divisions were filled unopposed; the Impartial Reporter of 21 May 1964, p. 7, names every nominee by division, including one newcomer, Mr. James Lynch, for the vacant Rosslea seat (added 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
